title: 番外 小时候的水母头（二合一）
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祝予八岁那年上了小学。

书包是周复之买的，文具由姥爷负责，姥姥跟奶奶帮她的新课本套了书皮，祝予她爷见没自己的份儿，大手一挥把小小的祝予叫过来：“爷给你剪个发型。”

小祝予搬来板凳，往上一坐，扭头示意她爷可以开始了。

剪刀咔嚓两下，很快剪完了，对着佣人搬来的镜子看了两眼，祝予撇撇嘴拽着自己的四根水母须须：“这不还是水母头嘛。”

周老爷子满意的拨弄一下她的刘海：“那能一样吗，现在是比之前更整洁的水母头!”

祝予从板凳上跳下去，踩着鹅卵石往屋里小跑去，嘴里喊着：“爸爸爸爸爸！！！”

周复之隔着老远就听见她的声音了。

“爸在这儿呢！”

从后院的门内探出一个脑袋，示意自己的位置，半分钟后，他接住了朝自己跑来的小炮弹。

“诶呦，人家上小学都瘦了，我看你怎么又重了不少。”

别看是小学生，首都的小学生可一点都不轻松，周复之加的那个宝爸群里，不少小学生三年级的时候就考过了KET，卷的让他直咂舌。

“为什么会变瘦，我爷做的饭很好吃。”

祝予上学后，周老爷子每天风雨无阻的去送饭，生怕自家大孙女吃不好。

“爸爸你看，我爷给绞的头。”

祝予晃了晃自己的脑袋瓜子。

“看见了，剪的还挺好，比我手艺强。”

“你还不去写作业啊，待会你妈就回来了。”

摸了摸她细软的头发，周复之把她抱起来。

心安理得搂住她爸的脖子，祝予说：“如果我现在能吃一根雪糕，那就可以立马去写。”

周复之：？

“吃什么雪糕，吃完雪糕拉的粑粑巨臭无比，你想炸掉咱们家厕所？”

“爸爸说谎，我前天还看到你躲在假山后面嗦冰棍！”

被戳穿的周复之面不改色道：“这就是那天晚上你妈妈把我赶到客房睡觉的原因。”

“因为吃雪糕，不仅拉屎，放屁也臭。”

其实不是，不过是因为那天周复之在衣帽间里找衣服穿的时候，突然看到了祝今也的裙子，沉默半晌，一时兴起，于是他伸出了罪恶之手——

偷穿了一下。

结果被去而复返的祝今也抓了个正着。

挣扎着扭身想给自己拉上拉链，嘴角还挂着诡异笑容的周复之一转头，跟手还放在门把手上，正用异样眼神看过来的祝今也目光撞了个正着。

裙子紧绷绷勒在肌肉上的周复之：“………”

Oh.nO.

于是当天晚上，祝今也把他赶到客房睡觉去了，并对抱着枕头依依不舍站在门外的周复之说：“等你穿裙子的身影彻底在我记忆中淡化，你才能睡回来。”

祝今也不想晚上睡着觉中途笑出声，太不符合她的人设。

周复之可怜兮兮的咬着枕头一角眼泪汪汪：“补药啊小也。”

面对祝予怀疑的眼神，周复之咳嗽一声。

“咳，这样吧，你先去写作业，写完爸爸跟妈妈商量一下，让人做甜甜的刨冰给你吃。”

虽然不符合预期，但祝予勉强能接受调剂。

“行吧……”

“我相信你哦爸爸，你一定要说服妈妈。”

祝予乖乖被抱着回去写作业了。

一个小时后，她听到了敲门声。

“请进。”

说完，房间门被

“妈妈，你下班了。”

“嗯。”

走到小孩身边，低头看了一眼桌面的卷子，看到她在写数学，祝今也问：“快结束了？”

祝予向来喜欢把最擅长的学科放到最后写。

“嗯，再写一篇日记，还有

仰头看着妈妈，祝予眨了眨眼，眼里带着渴求，撒娇的叫了一声：“妈妈~”

拍拍小孩的脑袋，祝今也好笑的看向装乖的水母头：“要吃刨冰？”

祝予连连点头：“想吃~”

“待会让你爸送来。”

她今天写作业的时间确实比往常早。

Zhu Yu went to primary school when she was eight years old.

The schoolbag was bought by Zhou Fuzhi, and her grandfather was responsible for the stationery. Her grandmother and grandmother helped put the book covers on her new textbooks. Seeing that it was not his fault, Zhu Yu called her little Zhu Yu over with a big wave of his hand: "I will give you a haircut."

Little Zhuyu moved a bench, sat on it, and turned to indicate to her father that it was time to start.

The scissors clicked twice and the cut was finished quickly. After looking at the mirror brought by the servant, Zhu Yu curled her lips and tugged at her four jellyfish whiskers: "Isn't this still a jellyfish head?"

Mr. Zhou fiddled with her bangs with satisfaction: "Can it be the same? Now the jellyfish head is neater than before!"

Zhu Yu jumped off the bench, stepped on the cobblestones and ran towards the house, shouting: "Dad, Daddy, Daddy!!!"

Zhou Fuzhi heard her voice from far away.

"Dad is here!"

A head popped out from the door of the backyard to indicate his position. Half a minute later, he caught the small cannonball running towards him.

"Hey, I lost weight in elementary school. I see why you have gained a lot of weight."

Even though they are primary school students, primary school students in the capital are not easy at all. In the group of dads that Zhou Fuzhi joined, many primary school students passed the KET exam when they were in third grade, and their test results made him stunned.

"Why are you losing weight? My father's food is delicious."

After Zhu Yu went to school, Mr. Zhou went to deliver meals every day, rain or shine, for fear that his eldest granddaughter would not be able to eat well.

"Dad, look, my father hanged his head."

Zhu Yu shook his head.

"I saw it. She's quite good at cutting it, and her skills are better than mine."

"Why don't you go do your homework? Your mother will be back later."

After touching her soft hair, Zhou Fuzhi picked her up.

Feeling at ease, Zhu Yu hugged her father's neck and said, "If I can eat an ice cream now, I can write right away."

Zhou Fuzhi:?

"What kind of ice cream are you eating? The cake you make after eating the ice cream is extremely smelly. Do you want to blow up our toilet?"

"Dad, you lied. The day before yesterday, I saw you hiding behind the rockery and playing popsicles!"

After being exposed, Zhou Fuzhi said without changing his expression: "This is why your mother drove me to the guest room to sleep that night."

"Because eating ice cream not only makes you poop, but also farts."

Actually no, it was just because when Zhou Fuzhi was looking for something to wear in the cloakroom that day, he suddenly saw Zhu Jinye's skirt. He was silent for a long time, and on a whim, he stretched out his sinful hand——

Sneaked through it.

As a result, Zhu Jin, who had left and returned, was also caught.

Zhou Fuyi, who was struggling to turn around and try to zip up the zipper for himself, turned around with a weird smile on his face, his hand still on the door handle, and Zhu Jin, who was looking over with a strange look, also caught his eye.

Zhou Fuzhi's skirt was tight on his muscles: "..."

Oh.nO.

So that night, Zhu Jin also rushed him to the guest room to sleep, and said to Zhou Fuzhi, who was standing outside the door holding the pillow reluctantly: "You can't sleep back until your figure in the skirt completely fades from my memory."

Zhu Jin also didn't want to laugh out loud in the middle of her sleep at night, it was too inconsistent with her personality.

Zhou Fuzhi pitifully bit the corner of the pillow with tears in his eyes: "Tonic, Xiaoye."

Facing Zhu Yu's suspicious eyes, Zhou Fuzhi coughed.

"Ahem, let's do this. You go and do your homework first. After you finish, dad and mom will discuss it and let someone make sweet shaved ice for you to eat."

Although it didn't meet expectations, Zhu Yu could barely accept the adjustment.

"Okay..."

"I believe in you, Dad, you must convince Mom."

Zhu Yu was carried back to do her homework obediently.

An hour later, she heard a knock on the door.

"Please come in."

After saying that, the door of the room was closed

"Mom, you're off work."

"Yeah."

Walking to the child, he looked down at the paper on the table and saw that she was writing mathematics. Zhu Jin also asked: "Is it almost over?"

Zhu Yu always likes to write about the subjects she is best at last.

"Well, write another diary, and

Looking up at her mother, Zhu Yu blinked, with longing in her eyes, and called out coquettishly: "Mom~"

Patting the child's head, Zhu Jin also looked at the pretending jellyfish head in a funny way: "Want some shaved ice?"

Zhu Yu nodded repeatedly: "I want to eat~"

“Your dad will send it to you later."

She did do her homework earlier than usual today.
